offering_description.value: Brown & Brown arranges insurance and employee benefits for businesses, public entities and individuals. Its retail brokers place coverage with insurers, while its wholesale brokers and program administrators help independent agents place specialty risks.

primary_services.value: retail insurance brokerage; employee benefits brokerage and consulting; specialty insurance program administration; wholesale insurance brokerage; risk management consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: Employers, businesses, nonprofits, independent insurance agents and brokers, and insurance carriers; B2C: Individuals and households buying personal insurance; B2G: Municipalities, school districts and other public entities

end_markets.value: commercial property and casualty insurance; employee benefits; specialty insurance; personal insurance; public sector risk management

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: Insurers pay commissions on policies placed and fees for administering specialty programs; service fees: Clients pay for brokerage, benefits consulting and risk management services
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Places carrier coverage for employers, public entities and households, directly and through independent brokers; service provider: Uses carrier underwriting authority to administer specialty programs and advises employers on benefits and risk

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Retail brokerage, employee benefits, specialty insurance programs and wholesale brokerage

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Retail brokerage teams serving employers, public entities and individuals; agents / brokers: Independent retail agents and brokers that place coverage through wholesale and specialty program teams

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Insurance producer, surplus lines and program administrator licensing and oversight by state insurance departments and overseas regulators
